entrypoints.summary: An attacker uploads a large source file to a GitLab repository; a user opens that file in GitLab.com's blob viewer.

affected_components.role: Computes oversized/collapsed state and, after remediation, stops normal viewer initialization before highlighting.
Selects the dedicated oversized-file viewer when isTooLarge is set.
Displays a non-rendering fallback with raw/download links.

code_slices.fixed: isTooLarge derives from tooLarge or collapsed metadata; initialization returns early and loadViewer selects too_large.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The added TooLargeViewer uses blob metadata to present raw/download links rather than a rendered file.
code_slices.vulnerable: Normal initialization called initHighlightWorker and switchViewer without the added oversized-state early return.

impact.affected_asset: Availability and responsiveness of the victim browser's GitLab page.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause users who open an attacker-controlled large repository source file to have its frontend viewer process and render that file.
impact.security_effect: Client-side denial of service through excessive browser CPU consumption and an unresponsive GitLab UI.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker-controlled repository can contain a multi-megabyte source file, and the report describes uploading such a file before a user views it.
Oversized or collapsed blob metadata was not used as a frontend boundary before blob-viewer initialization; the fix defines the boundary as viewer.tooLarge or viewer.renderError equal to collapsed.

Before the new early return, initialization reached initHighlightWorker and selected a simple or rich rendering viewer; processing and displaying large source files consumed excessive client CPU according to the disclosure.
The browser's GitLab page becomes unresponsive and may be stopped or reloaded, denying the viewer use of the page.

failure.operation: Client-side syntax-highlight/viewer initialization for an oversized source blob, including initHighlightWorker and viewer switching.

primary_invariant.statement: Blob metadata indicating tooLarge or renderError equal to collapsed must prevent expensive client highlighting and normal viewer rendering.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The pre-remediation initialization path invoked the highlight worker and switched viewer type without the subsequently added isTooLarge early return.

raw_refs.role: immutable remediation patch and test diff

quality.review_notes: The public disclosure supplies steps and an observed browser outcome, while the inspected patch concretely shows the added isTooLarge guard, viewer routing, and fallback component. The supplied artifacts do not establish a numeric threshold, affected release range, attached-file contents, or an observed local test run. The visible test diff provides an oracle contract for suppression of an auxiliary component, not a run result or a direct assertion that initHighlightWorker was skipped.

remediation.invariant_restored: When viewer metadata marks a blob too large or collapsed, the frontend returns before initializing highlighting, selects the dedicated too-large viewer, and presents raw/download access instead of rendering content.
mitigation_classes: Honor oversized/collapsed blob metadata before frontend initialization
Bypass highlight-worker and normal viewer rendering
Route oversized blobs to a download/raw fallback viewer

target.component: repository frontend blob content viewer and blob-viewer selection
